title: The Cottage | 3BR Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: The Cottage is a signature 3BR Blue Mountain Beach home featuring a 2023 renovation and private pool with a cabana. This luxury rental sleeps 10 by Royal Destinations.
description_expanded: Description: The Cottage by Royal Destinations Location: Blue Mountain Beach Address: 123 Sand Dunes Road, Santa Rosa Beach, FL Details: Your dream beachside getaway awaits at The Cottage, a beautifully renovated coastal retreat in one of the best locations on 30A, just 350 feet from private, deeded beach access. This charming three-bedroom, two-plus bath 30A rental effortlessly blends classic Cape Cod charm with modern luxury. Completely renovated in late 2023, The Cottage showcases thoughtful professional design and high-end furnishings, all while honoring its rich history in the sought-after Gulf side town of Blue Mountain Beach. Guests searching for 30A vacation rentals with private pools will be instantly drawn to this home which features a stunning heated pool, cabana, and outdoor kitchen designed for year-round enjoyment. This Blue Mountain vacation rental is a true oasis, ideal for relaxing, entertaining, and creating unforgettable beachside memories. The spacious single-level layout provides a warm, inviting setting for gatherings, game nights, and unwinding after a sun-filled day at the beach. Don’t miss the chance to stay in this exceptional 30A vacation rental. Reserve your stay today! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Short walk to private, deeded beach access (350 feet away). - Large private heated pool with lanai and cabana/changing room. - Outdoor kitchen, half bathroom, and outdoor shower. - Fully renovated in late 2023. - Professionally designed with high-end furnishings. - Parking for four vehicles in the driveway. - Short walk to Red Fish Taco and Blue Mountain Creamery. - Dining for 15 across table, bar, and breakfast nook. - Four additional beach accesses within 0.5 miles. - Located south of 30A on the Gulf side. - Four adult bikes included. - Beach towel service provided. *Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 3 Bedrooms / 2 Baths / Half Cabana Bath One Level: -Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed, Sleeper Sofa, Private Detached Bath -Guest Bedroom 2: King Bed, Shared Bath w/Bunk Room -Guest Bedroom 3: Bunk Beds, Shared Bath -Living / Dining / Kitchen /Laundry -Lanai / Pool Cabana-Changing Room / Cabana Outdoor Kitchen / Cabana Half Bath / Outdoor Shower Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
